issues.detail: The Greek 'εγραψα' (egrapsa) means 'I wrote' (referring to the letter/writing). The Vietnamese translation 'viết thơ' means 'wrote poetry,' which is a significant addition of a specific literary genre not present in the source text.

The Greek phrase 'την σπουδην υμων την υπερ ημων' indicates that the diligence is 'for our sake' or 'on our behalf'. The Vietnamese 'đối với chúng tôi' (towards/for us) captures the direction but loses the specific nuance of 'hyper' (on behalf of/for the sake of).
